connected_projects.Description: List of projects using the connector.

ip_cidr_range.Description: The range of internal addresses that follows RFC 4632 notation. Example: '10.132.0.0/28'.

machine_type.Description: Machine type of VM Instance underlying connector. Default is e2-micro

max_instances.Description: Maximum value of instances in autoscaling group underlying the connector.

max_throughput.Description: Maximum throughput of the connector in Mbps, must be greater than 'min_throughput'. Default is 300.

min_instances.Description: Minimum value of instances in autoscaling group underlying the connector.

min_throughput.Description: Minimum throughput of the connector in Mbps. Default and min is 200.

name.Description: The name of the resource (Max 25 characters).

network.Description: Name or self_link of the VPC network. Required if 'ip_cidr_range' is set.

region.Description: Region where the VPC Access connector resides. If it is not provided, the provider region is used.

self_link.Description: The fully qualified name of this VPC connector

state.Description: State of the VPC access connector.

subnet.Description: The subnet in which to house the connector

name.Description:
Subnet name (relative, not fully qualified). E.g. if the full subnet selfLink is
https://compute.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/{project}/regions/{region}/subnetworks/{subnetName} the correct input for this field would be {subnetName}"

project_id.Description: Project in which the subnet exists. If not set, this project is assumed to be the project for which the connector create request was issued.
